# Vectyr

> Vectyr is a brand infrastructure company that extracts, structures, and installs brand strategy for founders — making it usable by humans and AI tools alike.

Vectyr builds brand operating systems instead of logos. We extract your brand, structure it as a Brand Codex, and install it everywhere your team and AI tools work — so your brand shows up consistently across every touchpoint, human or machine.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://vectyr.com/): Overview of Vectyr — brand infrastructure for humans and AI.
- [About](https://vectyr.com/about): Founder story, methodology, and why Vectyr builds brand operating systems.
- [Team](https://vectyr.com/team): The strategists, designers, and engineers behind Vectyr.
- [Book a Demo](https://vectyr.com/demo): Walk through the BrandOS platform live.
- [Contact](https://vectyr.com/contact): Get in touch about brand strategy.
- [FAQs](https://vectyr.com/faqs): Answers about the Brand Codex, BrandOS, pricing, and process.

## Products

- [BrandOS](https://vectyr.com/brand-os): The operating environment that turns your Brand Codex into infrastructure your team and AI tools can use.
- [SiteOps](https://vectyr.com/site-ops): Done-for-you WordPress maintenance — secure, updated, and running without you managing it.

## Services

- Brand Strategy
- Brand Codex Development
- BrandOS Platform
- BrandPulse Maintenance
- Brand Infrastructure for AI
